# Data

```{r}
brfss <- read.csv("Data(random subset)/brfss_small.csv")
uscdi <- read.csv("Data(random subset)/uscdi_small.csv")
```

```{r}
head(uscdi)
```

# Clean Data

```{r}
 brfss_clean <- brfss |> 
  transmute(
    binge = X_RFBING6,   # outcome
    genhlth = GENHLTH,
    age_cat = X_AGEG5YR,
    menthlth= MENTHLTH,
    exerany = EXERANY2,
    smokday = SMOKDAY2,
    alcohol = ALCDAY4,
    diabetes = DIABETE4,
    edu  = EDUCA,
    income = INCOME3,
    marital = MARITAL,       
    sex = X_SEX,         
    vet = VETERAN3,      
    state = X_STATE
  ) |>
  
  mutate(
    # binge drinking
    binge = na_if(binge, 9L),
    binge = factor(binge, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("No", "Yes")),

    # general health
    genhlth = ifelse(genhlth %in% c(7, 9), NA, genhlth),
    genhlth = factor(genhlth, levels = 1:5,
                     labels = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor"),
                     ordered = TRUE),

    # age categories
    age_cat = na_if(age_cat, 14L),
    age_cat = factor(age_cat, levels = 1:13,
                     labels = c("18–24","25–29","30–34","35–39","40–44","45–49",
                                "50–54","55–59","60–64","65–69","70–74","75–79","80+"),
                     ordered = TRUE),

    # mental health
    menthlth = case_when(
      menthlth %in% c(77, 99) ~ NA_real_,
      menthlth == 88 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(menthlth)
    ),

    # exercise
    exerany = ifelse(exerany %in% c(7, 9), NA, exerany),
    exerany = factor(exerany, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Yes", "No")),

    # smoking
    smokday = ifelse(smokday %in% c(7, 9), NA, smokday),
    smokday = factor(smokday,
                     levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                     labels = c("Every day", "Some days", "Not at all")),

    # alcohol days
    alcohol = case_when(
      alcohol %in% c(777, 888, 999) ~ NA_real_,
      between(alcohol, 101, 199) ~ (alcohol - 100) * (30/7),
      between(alcohol, 201, 299) ~ alcohol - 200,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # diabetes
    diabetes = ifelse(diabetes %in% c(7, 9), NA, diabetes),
    diabetes = factor(diabetes,
                      levels = c(1,2,3,4),
                      labels = c("Yes","Gestational only",
                                 "No","Prediabetes")),

    # education level
    educ = ifelse(educ %in% c(9), NA, educ),
    educ = factor(educ, levels = 1:6, ordered = TRUE,
                  labels = c("No school","Elementary","Some HS","HS grad",
                             "Some college","College grad")),

    # income level
    income = ifelse(income %in% c(77, 99), NA, income),
    income = factor(income,
                    levels = 1:11,
                    labels = c("<$10k","$10–15k","$15–20k","$20–25k","$25–35k",
                               "$35–50k","$50–75k","$75–100k","$100–150k",
                               "$150–200k",">$200k"),
                    ordered = TRUE),
    
    # marital
    marital = ifelse(marital %in% c(9), NA, marital),
    marital = factor(marital,
                     levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6),
                     labels = c("Married","Divorced","Widowed",
                                "Separated","Never married",
                                "Unmarried couple")),

    # sex
    sex = factor(sex,
                 levels = c(1, 2),
                 labels = c("Male", "Female")),

    # veteran status
    vet = ifelse(vet %in% c(7, 9), NA, vet),
    vet = factor(vet,
                 levels = c(1, 2),
                 labels = c("Yes", "No")),

    # state
    state = factor(state)
  ) |>
  drop_na()
```

# Modeling

```{r}
set.seed(551)

# train/test
data_split <- initial_split(brfss_clean, prop = 0.8)
train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data  <- testing(data_split)

# cv
cv_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)

# recipe
brfss_recipe <- recipe(binge ~ ., data = train_data) |>
  step_naomit(all_predictors()) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |> 
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())  
```

## Logistic Regression

```{r}
# model spec
lasso_spec <- logistic_reg(penalty = tune(), 
                           mixture = tune()) |>
  set_engine("glmnet")|>
  set_mode("classification")

# grid
lasso_grid <- grid_regular(
  penalty(),
  mixture(),
  levels = 5
)

# workflow
lasso_wflow <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(brfss_recipe) |>
  add_model(lasso_spec)

# cv fit
lasso_fit <- lasso_wflow |>
  tune_grid(
    grid = lasso_grid,
    resamples = cv_folds
    )

# metrics
lasso_fit |> 
  collect_metrics() |>
  filter(.metric == "roc_auc")

# best params
best_lasso <- select_best(lasso_fit, metric = "roc_auc")

# final workflow
final_lasso_wflow <- lasso_wflow |>
  finalize_workflow(best_lasso)

# final fit
final_lasso_fit <- final_lasso_wflow |>
  fit(data = train_data)
```

```{r}
tidy(final_lasso_fit) |> 
  filter(estimate != 0)
```

## Random Forest

```{r}
# model spec
rf_model <- rand_forest(
  mtry  = tune(),
  trees = 500,
  min_n = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") |>
  set_mode("classification")

# grid
rf_grid <- grid_regular(
  mtry(c(1, 13)),
  min_n()
)

# workflow
rf_wflow <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(rf_recipe) |>
  add_model(rf_model)

# cv fit
rf_fit <- rf_wflow |>
  tune_grid(
    grid = rf_grid,
    resamples = cv_folds
    ) 

# metrics
rf_fit |> 
  collect_metrics() |>
  filter(.metric == "roc_auc") 

# best params
best_rf <- select_best(rf_fit, metric = "roc_auc")

# final workflow
final_rf_wflow <- rf_wflow |>
  finalize_workflow(best_rf)

# final fit
final_rf_fit <- final_rf_wflow |>
  fit(data = train_data)
```

```{r}
final_rf_fit |>
  extract_fit_parsnip() |>
  vip(num_features = 15, bar = TRUE, geom = "col") +
  labs(
    title = "Top Predictors of Binge Drinking (Random Forest)",
    subtitle = "BRFSS 2024"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

# Plots

# CDI

```{r}
# Remove BRFSS rows
uscdi_nobrfs <- uscdi |>
  filter(DataSource != "BRFSS")

# Keep only the liver disease mortality indicator
target_question <- 
  "Chronic liver disease mortality among all people, underlying cause"

uscdi_alcohol <- uscdi_nobrfs |>
  filter(Question == target_question)

# Keep only overall values (no race/sex splits)
uscdi_alcohol <- uscdi_alcohol |>
  filter(StratificationCategory1 == "Overall")

# Convert DataValue to numeric
uscdi_alcohol <- uscdi_alcohol |>
  mutate(
    DataValue = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", na_if(DataValue, "")))
  ) |>
  drop_na(DataValue)

# Keep only what we need
uscdi_clean <- uscdi_alcohol |>
  select(
    State = LocationAbbr,
    Year = YearStart,
    Question,
    Mortality = DataValue
  )

# If multiple years exist, average them
uscdi_state <- uscdi_clean |>
  group_by(State) |>
  summarise(
    Mortality = mean(Mortality, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create HighBurden (top 25% of states)
uscdi_state <- uscdi_state |>
  mutate(
    HighBurden = ifelse(
      Mortality > quantile(Mortality, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      "High", "Low"
    ),
    HighBurden = factor(HighBurden, levels = c("Low", "High"))
  )

```

## Modeling

```{r}
# ensure HighBurden is a factor
uscdi_state <- uscdi_state |>
  mutate(
    HighBurden = factor(HighBurden, levels = c("Low", "High"))
  )

# train/test split
data_split <- initial_split(uscdi_state, prop = 0.8)
train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data  <- testing(data_split)

# CV folds
cv_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)

# recipe
cdi_recipe <- recipe(HighBurden ~ ., data = train_data) |>
  update_role(State, new_role = "ID") |>
  step_naomit(all_predictors()) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())
```

```{r}
# model spec
lasso_spec <- logistic_reg(
  penalty = tune(),
  mixture = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("glmnet") |>
  set_mode("classification")

# grid
lasso_grid <- grid_regular(
  penalty(),
  mixture(),
  levels = 5
)

# workflow
lasso_wflow <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(cdi_recipe) |>
  add_model(lasso_spec)

# CV tuning
lasso_fit <- lasso_wflow |>
  tune_grid(
    grid = lasso_grid,
    resamples = cv_folds
  )

# metrics
lasso_fit |>
  collect_metrics() |>
  filter(.metric == "roc_auc")

# best params
best_lasso <- select_best(lasso_fit, metric = "roc_auc")

# final workflow
final_lasso_wflow <- lasso_wflow |>
  finalize_workflow(best_lasso)

# final fit
final_lasso_fit <- final_lasso_wflow |>
  fit(data = train_data)
```
